name: Full planning and design
bestFor: Couples starting from a date, or not even that.
summary: We plan the whole wedding with you: venue search, budget, design, every vendor, and the day itself.
included:
• Venue search and site visits, up to five
  • Budget built and tracked line by line
  • A design board: palette, florals, stationery, and floor plan
  • Vendor shortlists, contracts, and every meeting
  • Guest travel and hotel blocks
  • Rehearsal, and two planners on the day

name: Partial planning
bestFor: Couples with a venue booked and a few vendors in hand.
summary: We step in where you need us, finish the vendor team, design the day, and run it.
included:
• Vendor shortlists for everything still open
  • A design board: palette, florals, and floor plan
  • Monthly planning calls and a shared checklist
  • A written timeline for the day, confirmed with every vendor
  • Rehearsal, and two planners on the day

name: Wedding-month coordination
bestFor: Couples who planned it themselves and want to be guests at their own wedding.
summary: We take over eight weeks out, check every detail, and carry the day so you do not have to.
included:
• A handover meeting and a walk-through at the venue
  • Every vendor contract reviewed and confirmed
  • A written timeline for the day
  • Rehearsal, and one lead planner plus an assistant on the day
